Applicant :- Ayyub And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
This application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Criminal Case No. 14395 of 2021 in Case Crime No.168 of 2020, under sections 498A, 323, 307 I.P.C., and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Saroorpur,
District Meerut.
After arguing the matter at some length, Sri Ajay Kumar Mishra, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the instant application.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.
